stories.title: How Digital Payments Work at Light Speed

scenes.visual_prompt: Ultra-cinematic modern outdoor market scene full of energy and motion. One dominant narrator stands in the foreground, sharply in focus. In the background, multiple people are actively using smartphones—one scanning a QR code, another tapping to pay, another checking a phone. Subtle glowing light streaks and soft energy pulses briefly appear around phones, suggesting invisible digital activity. Light rays move rapidly between phones and upward into the air. Natural daylight, realistic modern environment, cinematic depth of field, no text, no logos, no watermark.
scenes.motion_prompt: dynamic background crowd motion, hands moving quickly on phones, brief light streaks flashing and flowing rapidly, subtle energy pulses, slight cinematic camera push-in toward narrator, narrator remains calm and steady
scenes.narration: फोन टैप किया… कुछ ही सेकंड में पेमेंट। लेकिन यह सिस्टम असल में काम कैसे करता है?

scenes.visual_prompt: Same outdoor market location. In the background, a customer holds a smartphone clearly visible, showing a clean generic payment screen with an amount displayed, such as 250 units, and a simple send action. No real app UI, no logos. Narrator remains dominant in the foreground. Cinematic realism, shallow depth of field, natural daylight, no text, no watermark.
scenes.motion_prompt: finger tapping send on phone, subtle phone glow, calm narrator posture, stable camera
scenes.narration: सब कुछ तब शुरू होता है, जब कोई राशि दर्ज करके भेजने का बटन दबाता है।

scenes.visual_prompt: As the payment is sent, elegant glowing light rays and flowing energy lines rise from the sender’s phone and travel rapidly through the air, symbolizing secure digital signals moving across connected systems. The narrator stays calm in the foreground. Light effects are abstract, smooth, and cinematic, not sci-fi weapons. Realistic modern environment, no text, no logos, no watermark.
scenes.motion_prompt: smooth light rays traveling quickly, gentle glow pulses, stable narrator, no camera shake
scenes.narration: सुरक्षित डिजिटल सिग्नल सिस्टम और बैंकों के बीच बिजली की रफ्तार से यात्रा करते हैं।

scenes.visual_prompt: Same location. A shopkeeper looks at their smartphone. The screen clearly shows a generic confirmation with the same amount received. No real app UI or logos. Light rays gently converge into the phone and fade. Narrator remains dominant in frame. Cinematic realism, natural daylight, no text, no watermark.
scenes.motion_prompt: phone confirmation appearing, soft glow fading, slight nod from receiver, calm background motion
scenes.narration: और कुछ ही सेकंड में पैसा सीधे रिसीवर के खाते में पहुँच जाता है।

scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic close-medium shot of the narrator in the same outdoor market environment. Background softly blurred. No digital effects now. Calm, thoughtful mood. Natural daylight, realistic modern setting, no text, no watermark.
scenes.motion_prompt: slow subtle head movement, ambient background motion
scenes.narration: ना कोई नकद पैसा चलता है… और ना ही कोई ऐप पैसा अपने पास रखती है।

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide cinematic shot of the outdoor market continuing its normal rhythm. People walk, trade, smile, and put phones away. Natural sunlight, calm atmosphere. Cinematic realism, no text, no watermark.
scenes.motion_prompt: gentle crowd movement, stable camera, soft ambient motion
scenes.narration: सिस्टम लगातार काम करता रहता है… और ज़िंदगी बिना रुके चलती रहती है।
